name: Video-based GSC Anchor (TMCV)
definition: A baseline compression framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that combines PLAS-based reordering with 2D video coding (HEVC) to compress attribute maps.
summary: The Video-based GSC Anchor (TMCV) is a 3D Gaussian Splatting compression framework that uses PLAS reordering and HEVC video coding, distinguishing itself by relying on standard codecs and explicit attribute grids rather than anchor-based hash grids.
